headline: European construction is in a fragile recovery (EU output +2.3% in 2025, Finland +6.1% off a low base), with AI/robotics construction tech attracting seed funding and EU Horizon calls steering toward circular, low-carbon and renovation solutions.
outlook_reason: Finnish and EU construction output turned up in 2025 and non-residential permits are rising, and EU regulation (EPBD recast) and Horizon calls favour renovation, smart-building and circular technologies, though Finnish residential building is still weak.

signals.title: All3 raises $25M seed for AI/legged-robot construction automation
signals.detail: Berlin/Zug startup All3 announced a $25M seed round for construction robotics and AI design platform.

signals.title: Sodex Innovations raises €4M
signals.detail: Construction-tech startup Sodex Innovations raised €4M led by Capmont Technology. The sources found did not say where it is based.

signals.title: Skanska to build €77M data centre in Finland
signals.detail: Core and shell work starts Q4 2026, completes Q3 2027. This follows a €100M Espoo data centre expansion started in April 2026. Data centres are a main driver of Finnish non-residential construction and of demand for heat recovery and building energy tech.

signals.title: Finland building permits up 19% in volume (12-month, August 2026)
signals.detail: Growth is non-residential-led. Residential recovery lags, and B+L does not expect a sustainable residential recovery before 2027.

signals.title: EPBD recast transposition deadline passed; Finland's implementation not complete
signals.detail: A FINVAC/REHVA report says Finland's EPBD implementation would not be ready by 29 May 2026. Finland is splitting it across several statutes. Energy requirements will tighten by 10%. I did not find the Environment Ministry's final timeline, so verify before advising.

signals.title: YIT restructures Finnish residential and building construction; wins Tikkurila school (€77M)
signals.detail: YIT began change negotiations to move to function-based teams, showing cost pressure in the incumbents. It also started a €77M educational building in Tikkurila.

signals.title: Italian construction-tech startup Pillar raises seed round (€12M-€15.2M, reports differ)
signals.detail: Pillar is building a digital platform for site and project data. The reports give different totals, and I could not reconcile them.

companies.name: YIT
companies.what: Largest Finnish builder/developer. Restructuring Finnish residential and building construction in 2026. Active in data centres, light rail and campus projects.

companies.name: Skanska Finland
companies.what: Contractor building data centres in Espoo and elsewhere in Finland (€77M and €100M projects), plus a Garmin facility (€29M) in Jyväskylä.

companies.what: Global elevator and escalator maker, with smart-building and urban-flow digital services. I found no October 2026 news on it.
